primary_sources.citation: Rudelson--Vershynin, Small ball probabilities for linear images of high dimensional distributions, IMRN 2015, arXiv:1402.4492
primary_sources.hypothesis_match: independent original-coordinate real inputs with one-dimensional densities bounded by one; no extra moments, iid, support, Gaussian or log-concavity assumptions

primary_sources.scope_note: not used for target because it assumes iid inputs and a sufficiently smooth Gaussian-field representation

mathematical_premises: For r=floor(||M||HS^2/||M||op^2)>=2, Corollary 8.6 gives P(||MY+alpha||<=t)<=min(1,(C_RV t/||M||op)^r).
Theorem 1.2 gives conditional scalar-linear density cap sqrt(2)/||MY+alpha||.
new_implication: If A_II=0 in an original-coordinate split I,J,K and B=A_IJ has floored stable rank at least two, then the full ambient form has density cap (C_RV/sqrt(2))*r_B/(r_B-1)/||B||op, with arbitrary remaining blocks and additional spectrum.
target_family: A_Nm=[[0,B_N,0],[B_N,0,0],[0,0,J_m/m]], B_N=diag(1,N^-1/2 I_N), N,m>=2. Exactly three eigenvalues have modulus>=1 and density cap sqrt(2) C_RV uniformly in N,m; this family has a continuous C0 density by independent convolution with the diffuse square bank.

partner.actual_application: On the same A_Nm family, the big cross pair plus two diffuse-bank coordinates gives core spectrum {1,-1,2/m,0}; with a=1,s=2/m,L=1 the partner bound is (576^(1/3)/2)m=4.1601676461038...m.

unresolved: Bare s_3(A)>=1 does not yet force a zero-self original-coordinate bank with stable-rank cross currency and nontrivial operator scale. Need structural routing into this or other paid mechanisms; arbitrary full target remains open.
next_step: Try to derive a cut/partition dichotomy that lower-bounds either ||A_IJ||op with floored stable rank>=2 under A_II=0 after an exact product-preserving reduction, or feeds failure into the grouped projected-crossing/ridge/hub compiler without selecting one weak singular direction.
